thread:
laura: Quick heads-up — planning prod deploy of release v2026.3 tomorrow 10:00 PT. Owners: @samir runtime, @mika db, @jamie rollback. Canary at 5% for 15m then ramp to 100% if green. Please ack availability and any blocked items.

samir: I can take runtime on-call 09:45-11:30 PT. Will watch latency and OOMs.

mika: DB migration is a zero-downtime add column + backfill job. Backfill runs in background; plan to pause if table writes spike. I can be on for the window.

jamie: I’ll own rollback path. We have image tags: docker.redwood.com/inference:v2026.3 and previous v2026.2-tagged. Rollback steps in runbook, snapshot created at 09:50.

elaine-cs: Can you call out any user-visible changes? CS needs a 1-paragraph summary + upgrade notes for customers on Dedicated.

tim-marketing: Marketing wants a shorter blurb for release notes page + 1 screenshot of the new console latency chart. ETA for assets?

laura: Visible changes: improved batching defaults, new config toggle for "predictive_caching", and minor UI latency chart. No user-facing API changes. Release notes draft: https://internal.redwood/release-notes/v2026.3 (please add comments). Screenshots: @samir can capture after canary if chart looks stable.

ops-bot: deploy-window reserved: 2026-06-12 17:00-18:00 UTC (10:00-11:00 PT).

samir: Smoke checklist (runtime):
```
# 1) quick health check
curl -sS https://prod.redwood/api/health | jq .status  # expect "ok"
# 2) tail canary logs
kubectl -n prod logs -l app=inference-canary --tail=200 | grep -i error
# 3) token throughput sanity
./tools/token-load-check --target=canary --duration=60s
```

mika: DB smoke checks:
```
# verify migration applied
psql -h pg.prod -c "\d+ inference_events" | grep new_column
# verify backfill progress
SELECT count(*) FROM inference_events WHERE new_column IS NULL;
```

jamie: Rollback quick steps:
```
# 1) scale down canary
kubectl -n prod scale deployment/inference --replicas=0 --selector=canary
# 2) redeploy previous image
kubectl -n prod set image deployment/inference inference=docker.redwood.com/inference:v2026.2
# 3) monitor
kubectl -n prod rollout status deployment/inference --timeout=5m
```

laura: Canary policy: 5% traffic -> 15m observation window -> health gates (error rate <0.5%, median latency < 300ms). If any gate fails, auto-fallback to v2026.2.

samir: I'll set alarms and a short dashboard for the canary route (latency, 99th, errors, CPU, mem). Will post link when ready.

elaine-cs: For CS notes: short summary + known issues. One question: will prompts/embeddings behavior change?

laura: No embedding model changes. Prompting behavior unchanged. Known issue: rare transient 429s during aggressive backfill; mitigated by token-throttling config. Add that to notes.

tim-marketing: I'll draft the release blurb and ask design for screenshot by EOD today. Can we get a short quote about latency improvements?

samir: Expect ~10-15% median latency reduction on long-tail requests with new batching. Quote OK: "~10% median latency improvement for long sequences."

elaine-cs: Acknowledged, prepping CS playbook and canned responses for customers who notice 429s.

laura: Final confirmations: @samir @mika @jamie please react with :white_check_mark: if you plan to be at the window. Also confirm runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/prod-deploy-v2026.3

samir: :white_check_mark:

mika: :white_check_mark:

jamie: :white_check_mark: I’ll be on standby for 30m after full ramp.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started at 10:00 PT -> route 5% traffic to inference:v2026.3-canary.

laura: Will kick off deploy at 10:00 PT. If anyone needs to shift, speak now. Otherwise marking this thread for deploy-day checklist and cross-team comms.

elaine-cs: I'll send CS an internal heads-up doc at 09:30 PT with steps and contacts.

samir: Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/d/abc123/canary-inference (watch latency + errors).

laura: Thanks everyone. Post-mortem if anything flares. If green at +15m we ramp to 100% with the automated policy.

jamie: One more note: backup DB snapshot created and verified at 09:52 PT.
